# web-noise-suppressor 0.4.1 (vendored)

From `@sapphi-red/web-noise-suppressor@0.4.1` (MIT, see LICENSE), npm integrity
`sha512-hy2GnF079+zi4n9BZUf+GGIQ1IofApAk6rgGMyMQ3soHfz/GKu1pcCsmePyIHVvUuv1LrFudw9BmmBqoOKay5w==`.
Only the RNNoise worklet, its loader and the two RNNoise wasm builds are kept; files are unmodified.
Used by `calls.js` for the "Strong" noise-cancellation setting. Requires `'wasm-unsafe-eval'` in the
inbox's `script-src`.
